# The API surface, as recorded

**Generated by `node describe-api.mjs`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every route, field, type and status below was read out of a real response from the
pilot control plane — one Atlas 800I A2 with eight Ascend 910B3 cards — captured
through each persona's own Keycloak token.

This exists so that a design team never has to ask "does the API return X". If X is
not here, it was not captured, and if it was not captured it does not exist: the
cluster is gone and there is no second chance to look.

## How to read it

- **Scope** is what the control plane requires to serve the route. A route with no
  scope entry is refused, by design — see `internal/authz/scope.go`.
- **Observed** is which persona got which HTTP status. A 403 is a correct answer and
  is recorded as faithfully as a 200; a screen that cannot render one is incomplete.
- **optional** on a field means some rows in the recording did not carry it. Those
  are the fields that render blank for reasons nobody can reproduce later.

## What a refusal looks like

A design that has never seen these will not have a place to put them.

**refusals-no-credential** — HTTP 401

```json
{"error":"unauthenticated","errorDescription":"a valid bearer token is required"}
```
